title: Kou Sawada's Risque Comedy Manga Yumeneconnect Gets TV Anime
content:
The cast members include:

Yūsuke Kobayashi as Yūhi Takamiya

Yū Sasahara as Nano

Sōta Yokote ( To Your Eternity season 3) is directing the anime at Studio Massket . Gigaemon Echikawa ( Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden , A Galaxy Next Door , A Gatherer's Adventure in Isekai ) is both writing and supervising the series' scripts. Yoshihiro Watanabe ( Haganai , Overflow , Adam's Sweet Agony ) is designing the characters. Hayato Matsumura is composing the music. Lantis is in charge of music production, and SHOCHIKU anime is presenting the anime.

The manga centers on Yūhi Takamiya, a sickly boy who has been absent from school since his first day of high school. In his loneliness, he one day cries out, "I want friends!" in the middle of his room. As if in response, an alien from the planet Pokotsun named Nano appears before him, making her aggressive sales pitches to various ridiculous products, including a being designated as the most dangerous form of life in the galaxy, all of which will make Yūhi's life just a little bit more stimulating.

Sawada launched the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in September 2024. Kodansha will publish the manga's 10th compiled book volume on Friday.

Sources+ Yumeneconnect anime's website , Comic Natalie

title: Manga 'Kimi to Koete Koi ni Naru' Ends Serialization
content:
Chihiro Yuzuki 's Kimi to Koete Koi ni Naru ( With You, Our Love Will Make It Through ) manga ended its serialization on Wednesday. The 133th and final chapter marked the end of its five-year run.

Yuzuki began serializing the supernatural romance manga, also abbreviated as Kimikoe , on the Manga Mee service in May 2021. Shueisha published the 12th volume on September 26. The 13th volume will be the final volume. Kimikoe has a cumulative 1.8 million copies of its volumes in print.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English in July 2024 and released the fourth volume on March 24. The fifth volume is planned for a January 26, 2027 release.

A 12-episode television anime adaptation produced by Millepensee aired in Fall 2025. Remow licensed the anime series and streamed it on Crunchyroll with subtitles and an English dub.

Official manga site: https://manga-mee.jp/detail/52036 Official manga X: @ kimikoe_news

title: Manga 'Yumene Connect' Gets TV Anime
content:
Production company Shochiku opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Kou Sawada 's Yumene Connect manga on Wednesday, revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video.

Voice actors Yuusuke Kobayashi ( Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu ) and Yuu Sasahara ( Shadows House ) are starring as Yuuhi Takamiya and Nano, respectively.

Staff

• Director: Souta Yokote ( Fumetsu no Anata e Season 3 )

Series Composition, Script: Gigaemon Ichikawa ( Black Torch ) Character Design: Yoshihiro Watanabe ( Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai ) Music: Hayato Matsumura ( Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai sareta Majo desu. ) Music Production: Lantis Studio: Studio Massket Planning, Executive Producer: Shochiku

Sawada began serializing the sci-fi romance manga in Weekly Shounen Magazine in September 2024. Kodansha released the ninth volume on July 16, with the tenth volume scheduled for an October 16 release.

Synopsis On his first day of high school, Yuuhi Takamiya misses school due to an illness, leaving him isolated and lonely. His life changes when Nano, a clumsy alien from Planet Pokotsun, suddenly arrives from space with various bizarre products. Yuuhi's high school life instantly turned chaotic, surrounded by gorgeous girls.

title: The Apothecary Diaries Film's New Video Unveils Miyuki Sawashiro, Ai Mikami in Cast
content:
TOHO animation began streaming a character promotional video for The Apothecary Diaries : The Late Lady's Treasure ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto: Bо̄hi no Hihо̄ ), the upcoming anime film based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series, on Wednesday. The video highlights the consort Ruoqing and the lady-in-waiting Yinshan, and announces their voice cast.

The new cast members include:

Miyuki Sawashiro as the middle level courtesan Ruoqing, who died five years ago in the Emperor's inner palace, and whose dying wish was to have her remains return to her homeland five years after her death.

Ai Mikami as Yinshan, Ruoqing's former lady-in-waiting, and the current attendant of Mu Qing, and a general servant of the Bi clan.

The film features a brand-new story by the original novel series' author Hyuganatsu . It follows Maomao and Jinshi as they travel to the hometown of a concubine who died five years ago in the imperial harem, to return her remains to her homeland. There, they encounter pirates, hidden treasures, the secret of the Empress' remains, and a mysterious boy who holds the key to the story.

Mariya Ise joins the cast as key character and Bi clan son Mu Qing. Nobuo Tobita plays Bi clan head Birō. Kumiko Watanabe plays Birō's wife Shūu. Hirofumi Nojima plays the Bi clan's eldest son Bisen. (All name Romanizations not confirmed.)

Kenshō Ono plays Kajadan river pirate leader Suija, while Ryōta Takeuchi plays Suija's subordinate Eishō, and Jirō Saitō plays the late former Kajadan leader Kaja. (All name Romanizations not confirmed.)

The film will open in theaters in Japan on December 11. Crunchyroll announced on Thursday it has acquired the North American and worldwide rights (excluding Asia but including India) to the film. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will announce the release date at a later time.

The third television anime season premiered on October 2 at 11:00 p.m. (10:00 a.m. EDT) in the "Friday Anime Night" programming block on NTV and 29 affiliated channels for its first cours (quarter of a year), and its second cours will premiere in April 2027.

The anime's first season premiered in October 2023 with the first three episodes, and aired for two cours . Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan and is also streaming an English dub .

The second anime season premiered in January 2025 on Nippon TV 's FRIDAY ANIME NIGHT programming block, and aired for two consecutive cours . Crunchyroll is streaming the second season, and it is also streaming an English dub .

J-Novel Club publishes the novel series digitally, and it describes the story:

In the East is a land ruled by an emperor, whose consorts and serving women live in a sprawling complex known as the hougong, the rear palace. Maomao, an unassuming girl raised in an unassuming town by her apothecary father, never imagined the rear palace would have anything to do with her—until she was kidnapped and sold into service there. Though she looks ordinary, Maomao has a quick wit, a sharp mind, and an extensive knowledge of medicine. That's her secret, until she encounters a resident of the palace at least as perceptive as she is: the head eunuch, Jinshi. He sees through Maomao's façade and makes her a lady-in-waiting to none other than the Emperor's favorite consort... so she can taste the lady's food for poison!

Hyuganatsu began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2011. Shufunotomo began publishing the novels in print volume with illustrations by Shino in August 2014. Nekokurage launched an ongoing manga adaptation in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in May 2017. Square Enix Manga & Books is releasing the manga adaptation in English. The company is also publishing the novels in print. Viz Media is releasing Minoji Kurata 's separate manga adaptation titled The Apothecary Diaries: Maomao’s Notes on the Inner Palace .

title: Black Clover Just Gave Yuno a Powerful New Weapon – Watch
content:
Yuno is getting his chance to shine in the Spade Kingdom Arc after he suffered a massive setback during Zenon’s attack on the Golden Dawn Squad. Now that the Fall 2026 anime season is finally here, Black Clover returns with a brand new season after making fans wait for five years. As a Weekly Shonen Jump original written and illustrated by Yuki Tabata, which later transitioned to the Jump GIGA magazine, it’s one of the biggest action fantasies of all time. While the manga has already reached its conclusion this year, the anime still has to adapt the two final arcs from the manga.

The anime went on a hiatus in 2021 after adapting the initial phase of the Spade Kingdom Raid Arc, but the real fight will be featured in the latest season. It’s the most intense arc of the anime that takes place in the Spade Kingdom, the stronghold of the Dark Triad, who have been planning to unleash chaos upon the world. Season 2 is off to a strong start since it immediately rushes into action after the Magic Knights and mages from the Heart Kingdom have waited long enough to finally stop the villains. After facing his biggest defeat at the hands of Zenon, Yuno is back in action with a brand new weapon.

Black Clover Season 2 Gives Yuno the Time to Shine With a New Weapon

Yuno unleashes his Spirit of Boreas in the second episode of Season 2 during his rematch against. When the villain attacked the Golden Dawn, Yuno found himself terribly outnumbered, and it almost cost him his life. However, things have changed now since he is more than ready to avenge his squad. His Spirit of Boreas is by far the most powerful technique that he developed after his defeat against Zenon. It unleashes streams of wind that are capable of shattering devil-reinforced Bone Magic. Yuno developed this technique to break through Zenon’s solid defense, but the anime hasn’t shown how effective it will be. Regardless, anime-only fans can expect it to be one of the greatest fights in the series .

The fight isn’t going to be longer than necessary, but it features all the excitement fans can hope for. Before the first season was over, Yuno faced his biggest challenge when he saw half of his squad had been wiped out by Zenon. Not to mention that he was also too powerless to stop the villain from abducting his Captain. This was a major turning point in his life, not only because of the tragedy, but he also learned the truth about his origins. While the latest fight begins with Langris and Yuno on the same side, things will change drastically in the middle of the battle. Not only that, but Spirit of Boreas isn’t the only card he has up his sleeve against the villain. The fight will continue in the upcoming Episode 3 , which will be out on October 17th, 2026.

title: One-Punch Man Season 3 Cour 2 Visual and Trailer Revealed, Sets January 2027 Release
content:
One-Punch Man Season 3 Cour 2 anime revealed a new visual and trailer, along with a January 2027 release date. JAM Project will once again perform the opening theme for the anime. The new song is titled “Never Done -SUPREME POWER VS ULTIMATE FEAR-.”

Studio J.C Staff is in charge of the animation, and the second part was previously confirmed for a 2027 release. You can see the new visual below.

Also check out the new trailer:

One Punch Man was created by ONE as a webcomic manga in 2009. It got a digital manga remake with art by Yusuke Murata in June 2012. The manga is serialized on Shueisha’s Tonari no Young Jump website, while Viz Media licensed it in English and is serializing it in Weekly Shonen Jump . Studio MADHOUSE animated the breakout first season, which aired from October to December 2015. Studio J.C. Staff took over for season 2, which aired from April to July 2019. The 3rd season was announced in August last year. 2025 marked the 10th anniversary of the anime .

The story follows Saitama, a man who became a hero for fun. He had his famous daily training regime for 3 years (100 pushups, 100 squats, 100 situps, 10km run), which got him so overpowered that he could take any opponent down with a single punch. Besides all the major villains or evildoers, Saitama also meets a bunch of quirky heroes from the Hero Association and is constantly getting underestimated while being the one to actually protect humanity. The third season focuses on the ‘Hero Hunter’ Garo .

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest Action Anime of Fall 2026 Is Finally Here With a Stunning Premiere
content:
As the second weekend of Fall 2026 has largely come to an end, all the major new anime scheduled to arrive on Crunchyroll this fall have premiered, including the season’s darkest action anime. The anime industry has evolved significantly over the years, increasingly embracing darker elements that bring a sense of realism to many series. While shonen anime have gradually incorporated darker themes, their counterpart, seinen, has always built its foundation on them.

Looking at modern shonen anime such as Jujutsu Kaisen and Gachiakuta , both series embrace qualities typically associated with seinen, unafraid to depict heavy themes while grounding them in personal journeys. However, seinen series have always explored such elements, as seen in well-known titles such as Vinland Saga and Attack on Titan . This fall, the new seinen anime The Vermilion Mask , which has been building anticipation for its release, premiered on Crunchyroll on October 10. Its first episode has already laid the foundation for why it is Fall 2026’s darkest action anime and could emerge as the darkest anime of the year.

Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 Seinen Anime Nails a Perfect Modern Anime Trope

The Vermilion Mask , adapted into an anime by 100Studio , follows a protagonist named Peru on a peculiar journey across the nation with the specific task of destroying masks that grant incredible power to whoever wears them. Peru’s motivation stems from a traumatic childhood event in which he massacred his master and fellow apprentices after losing control while wearing the Mask of the Warrior, created by his master. Since then, Peru has been determined to destroy the masks. However, that is easier said than done, as many others seek to use the masks created by his master, Gaston, for their own benefit.

The premiere episode depicts this conflict as the king of a region seeks to use the power of the masks to bring everyone under his heel, with the anime unafraid to depict gore to highlight their destructive power. What stands out is Peru’s determination to achieve his goal. Having been on this journey for a long time and already mastered the powers of other masks, he is portrayed as an agile and quick-thinking protagonist. The action is appealing and dynamic, thanks to Peru’s use of multiple masks, including the Spider Mask, which effectively turns him into Spider-Man. The Chameleon Mask and another unique mask that highlights Peru’s emotional depth make the anime even more engaging.

By the end of the premiere, however, the anime delivers an even better conclusion by introducing other characters who appear to have endured similar trauma, placing them in the same situation as the protagonist before ending on an epic and dark cliffhanger. Within just 20 minutes, The Vermilion Mask delivers an impressive premiere, establishing itself as one of Crunchyroll’s darkest anime of Fall 2026 . If the series maintains this momentum, it would not be an understatement to call it the darkest action anime of the year.

title: The Promised Neverland, Blue Box Manga Both Get New Novels
content:
The Yakusoku no Neverland ~10-nen-me no Okurimono~ novel, commemorating the manga's 10th anniversary, depicts the story of Emma and the other children after the manga's final episode. The novel will also include stories about Cislo and the other members of the Lambda group, and Phil and the rest of the younger children.

The manga's first novel, Yakusoku no Neverland : Norman kara no Tegami ( The Promised Neverland : A Letter from Norman, image right), shipped in Japan in June 2018. The second novel, Yakusoku no Neverland : Mama-tachi no Tsuisōkyoku ( The Promised Neverland : Moms' Song of Remembrance), shipped in January 2019. The second novel focuses on Isabella and Sister Krone.

The third novel , Yakusoku no Neverland : Senyū-tachi no Record ( The Promised Neverland : Record of War Buddies), shipped in October 2020. The novel focuses on Yuugo and Lucas. The fourth novel, Yakusoku no Neverland : Omoide no Film-tachi ( The Promised Neverland : The Films of Memories), shipped in December 2020. The novel contained stories told in the first anime season's DVD booklet, and in the Jump Giga magazine, as well as a new short story.

Nanao also wrote all four previous novels.

Shirai and Demizu launched the manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in August 2016, and the series ended in June 2020. Shueisha published the manga's 20th and final volume in October 2020. Viz Media publishes the manga digitally and in print in North America. MANGA Plus also publishes the manga digitally in English.

A new bonus one-shot chapter for the manga titled "War vs. Peace" was published in Weekly Shonen Jump on August 24.

The first anime adaptation of The Promised Neverland premiered in January 2019. Aniplex of America streamed the anime on Crunchyroll , Hulu , Funimation , and HIDIVE as it aired. The second season premiered in January 2021. Funimation streamed the series as it aired in Japan.

title: 3 Things You Need to Know for One Piece Elbaph Arc’s Return
content:
One Piece is on another hiatus after airing the first 26 episodes of the Elbaph Arc. The anime is currently at a crucial phase as the Final Saga commences the highly anticipated arc fans have been waiting for since Little Garden. The story has come a long way in almost three decades, but it’s still far from over. The Elbaph Arc is by far the most crucial arc of the series as it brings the Straw Hat Pirates to the fabled land of the Giants. Not only does the anime introduce the Holy Knights and more new characters, but it also sets up the biggest challenge Luffy and the others have to face yet.

Just after the Egghead Incident Arc, the anime went through a massive change in schedule for the first time since its debut. Instead of releasing weekly episodes, One Piece has taken a seasonal schedule to maintain the quality of the animation. The anime confirmed that it will release 26 episodes each year, and the batch of episodes for this year has all been released. While the anime ends its latest episode on a cliffhanger, fans have been awaiting updates on its return . Here’s a look at everything we know so far.

3) One Piece Will Return With New Episodes in 2027

The anime will be releasing new episodes next year, although the exact release date hasn’t been revealed yet. Since One Piece is taking the stage during this year’s Jump Festa as well, we can expect updates on the anime’s return before the end of the year. Just like each year, fans can expect a number of announcements and even new projects during the Jump Festa. It’s the largest anime and manga convention held by Shueisha, which is why One Piece is always in the spotlight as the most popular Shonen Jump manga. Not only that, but it’s also confirmed that the anime will be returning to Crunchyroll, where you can catch up with all the episodes. Netflix will also be airing the episodes weekly after a one-week delay due to licensing issues. The streaming giant got rights to the anime during the Egghead Incident Arc, and since then, it has been adding more episodes to its library.

2) One Piece ‘s Elbaph Arc Will Take a Massive Turn After Anime’s Return

The arc begins after Luffy and the others escape from Egghead Island. Upon reaching Elbaph, it doesn’t take long for things to go downhill, especially with the arrival of the Holy Knights. They will serve as the primary antagonist of the latest arc, although the anime hasn’t shown just how far they’re willing to go to get what they want. Elbaph has always been a target of the World Government, but they’re speeding things up due to all the major events happening around the world. The anime’s latest episode ends on a cliffhanger, but things will keep going downhill for the crew. Not only that, but the anime will also focus on Loki, the Prince of Elbaph, who has been serving his sentence after killing his father. Manga fans already know about the plot twists and intense battles the anime will adapt next year, as the story enters one of its most exciting phases yet.

1) One Piece Will Be Releasing Its Canon Movie

Thanks to the change in schedule, One Piece finally got an opportunity to release its first-ever feature-length movie following the main story from the manga. The movie will be released next year , although there’s no release date for this project as well. However, we can expect it to be released after the anime’s return since the studio still has to adapt a few more chapters before kicking off the God Valley flashback. Anime movies are typically released in Japanese theatres first, and they take at least a few weeks or a month to premiere across the globe. This is the norm even for popular anime, and One Piece might not be the exception. Since there has been no announcement so far that the anime will be released domestically and internationally at the same time, we can expect quite a bit of delay before the film reaches the U.S. theatres.

What are you most looking forward to when the Elbaph Arc returns, and which chapter’s adaptation are you most excited for? Let me know in the comments below!

title: Tsūkaku Tantei Tsūtenji Natsume, Isekai Yurutto Survival Seikatsu Manga Both End
content:
The November issue of Kadokawa 's Monthly Dragon Age magazine published the final chapter of Yasu Hiromoto and Sayaka Itsuki 's Tsūkaku Tantei Tsūtenji Natsume ( The pain sensation detective: Natsume [splendid case files by the five senses] ) manga on Friday. The magazine also revealed that Yōichi Nishio 's manga adaptation of Ayano 's Isekai Yurutto Survival Seikatsu light novel will end in its next issue on November 9.

The Tsūkaku Tantei Tsūtenji Natsume manga centers on Arata, a boy with a keen intuition, and his encounter with "super-sensates," those who have a mastery of all their five senses.

The manga launched in Monthly Dragon Age in September 2025. Hiromoto writes the story and Itsuki draws the art. Kadokawa published the manga's first compiled book volume on April 9, and will publish the second volume on November 9.

Hiromoto and Kubaru Sakanoichi launched their Tengen Hero Wars ( Tengen Eiyū Taisen ) manga in Coamix 's Comic Zenon magazine in 2021. The manga ended in its 10th and final volume, which shipped in Japan on March 19. Titan Comics is releasing the manga in English, and will release the fourth volume on December 22. Coamix is also officially releasing the manga digitally in English.

Itsuki drew the Marronni ☆ Yell manga based on Tochigi TV 's real-life idol group of the same name, and is credited for the original work on Sakura no Chikai , the 2018 short anime based on the idol group. Itsuki also drew Mental Model Research , a spinoff manga of Ark Performance 's Arpeggio of Blue Steel manga. The manga launched in Shōnengahōsha 's Monthly Youngking Ours GH magazine in January 2019, and ended in January 2020.

Nishio launched the Isekai Yurutto Survival Seikatsu manga in Monthly Dragon Age in September 2020. Kadokawa published the manga's 10th volume on June 9.

Ayano launched the original novel in March 2020, with illustrations by Waon Inu (artumph).

The novel centers on Hokage Shinomiya, a high schooler who dreams of living on a desert island. He and some other classmates are inexplicably transported to a mysterious island in another world. Without electricity, gas, or water systems, it is Hokage's survival skills that put him in a leadership position.

Nishio launched a spinoff manga for Kenji Saitō and Akinari Nao 's Trinity Seven manga titled Trinity Seven -Revision- in Kadokawa 's Bessatsu Dragon Age magazine in June 2019. The three-volume manga ended in September 2022. Nishio also launched the Ninja Tensei Shinobikill (Ninja Reincarnation Shinobikill) manga in Monthly Dragon Age in March 2018.
